name: Gomen ne, Otaku-kun
source:
The protagonist, an ordinary high school girl, decides to kill some time by teasing her gloomy, introverted classmate, “Otaku-kun.”  
But what started as a little teasing seems to have made Otaku-kun completely misunderstand!? LOLOLOLOLOL

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21882]freem[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位普通的女高中生，她决定通过戏弄阴郁内向的同学“宅男”来消磨时间。
不过，一开始的小小的调侃，似乎让御宅君彻底误会了！？哈哈哈哈哈
